summary: Build governed AI workflows for FP&A forecasting, variance analysis, and reporting. Explore the five-day course and practical finance exercises.
lede: AI-augmented FP&A applies generative AI and machine learning to planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and reporting with human review. For FP&A analysts, finance business partners, and managers, the course develops governed workflows for recurring finance tasks, including scenario modelling, validating forecast and variance outputs against source data, and drafting reports from approved information. Exercises use Copilot for Excel, Power BI, and Python forecasting to create practical review and control records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who own planning, forecasting, performance analysis, or management reporting and need to assess where AI can support those workflows safely.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management accounts is expected. You should be comfortable working with Excel spreadsheets. Python programming is not required; the forecasting exercises use guided workflows and focus on interpreting and validating results.
